title: Senior Software Engineer – Backend
description: We are looking for a Senior Backend Software Engineer with strong experience in Python or Node.js, microservices, and cloud infrastructure (AWS/GCP). You will design and implement scalable APIs, lead technical architecture decisions, and mentor junior engineers. Experience with distributed systems, containerization (Docker/Kubernetes), and CI/CD pipelines is required.

title: Full Stack Developer
description: Seeking a Full Stack Developer proficient in React, TypeScript, and a backend language (Node.js or Python). You will build end-to-end features, collaborate with product and design teams, write unit and integration tests, and ensure performance and accessibility standards. Experience with PostgreSQL and cloud deployment is required.

title: Machine Learning Engineer
description: We are hiring a Machine Learning Engineer to build, train, and deploy ML models at scale. You will work on NLP, recommendation systems, and computer vision pipelines. Strong Python, TensorFlow or PyTorch, and data engineering skills are required. Experience with MLflow, feature stores, and model serving infrastructure is preferred.

title: DevOps / Platform Engineer
description: Looking for a DevOps/Platform Engineer to build and maintain cloud infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines, and developer tooling. You will manage Kubernetes clusters, implement observability solutions, and drive infrastructure-as-code practices using Terraform. Strong AWS/GCP and scripting experience required.

title: Financial Analyst
description: We are seeking a Financial Analyst to support financial planning, budgeting, and variance analysis. Responsibilities include building financial models in Excel, preparing management reports, conducting scenario analysis, and supporting the annual planning cycle. CFA or CPA certification is a plus.

title: HR Business Partner
description: Seeking an experienced HR Business Partner to support business leaders on talent management, employee relations, performance management, and organizational development. You will partner with leadership on workforce planning, drive employee engagement initiatives, and ensure compliance with employment law.

title: Investment Banking Analyst
description: Join our Investment Banking team as an Analyst. Responsibilities include financial modeling (DCF, LBO, comps), pitch book preparation, market research, and supporting M&A and capital markets transactions. Strong Excel, PowerPoint, and financial analysis skills required. MBA or CFA preferred.

title: Enterprise Sales Manager
description: We are looking for an Enterprise Sales Manager to drive revenue growth by managing complex sales cycles, building executive relationships, and closing large deals. Experience with CRM systems (Salesforce), consultative selling, and SaaS products is required. You will own a territory quota and lead a small team.

title: Civil / Structural Engineer
description: Seeking a Civil/Structural Engineer for infrastructure and building design projects. Responsibilities include structural analysis, CAD drafting, project management, and coordination with contractors. PE license preferred. Experience with AutoCAD, Revit, and STAAD Pro required.

title: Clinical Nurse – ICU
description: We are hiring an experienced ICU Nurse to provide critical care to patients. Responsibilities include monitoring vital signs, administering medications, coordinating with physicians, and educating patients and families. BSN required, MSN preferred. Active RN license and at least 2 years ICU experience required.
